messages:
sam: heads-up — deploybot blocked publish for auth-service:v2026.03.20 (buildid=abc123) to eu-west-1. provenance attestation failed at registry step.

deploybot: publish halted: provenance subject mismatch for auth-service:v2026.03.20 in eu-west-1.

ci-bot: registry error snippet:
```
Error: provenance.attestation.subject != manifest.config.Labels.buildid
expected: "abc123"
found:    "def456"
code: PROVENANCE_SUBJECT_MISMATCH
```

kelly: wait — did the CI reuse an existing image digest or did metadata stamping fail?

sam: we retriggered a build to pick a minor deps update. CI sets label buildid from CI_JOB_ID. looks like pushed image carries the old buildid label.

juan: my hunch: retag step pulled a cached manifest and didn't rewrite labels. possible in the uploader when layers identical.

tara: confirm that nothing propagated to canaries? deploybot says publish stopped before mirror.

deploybot: correct — publish gate failed, no mirrors updated, no canary assignment.

kelly: mitigation suggestion: pin service to last known-good digest and retag that digest to a temporary stable tag for this change window.

sam: propose steps:
1) apply write-hold on tag `v2026.03.20` (block new pushes)
2) retag previous good digest `sha256:feedfacecafebabe...` -> `v2026.03.20-stable`
3) allow publish of `v2026.03.20-stable` after manual approval by release lead
4) open PR with release note + attach attestation logs + create RCA ticket #3422

juan: +1. also add short rollback note in the PR in case a later push reintroduces the bad tag.

ci-bot: retag commands (CI account):
```
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name auth-service --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:feedfacecafebabe... --region eu-west-1 
aws ecr put-image --repository-name auth-service --image-tag v2026.03.20-stable --image-manifest file://manifest.json --region eu-west-1
```

tara: I'll do manual approve after retag. who will open the PR?

sam: I'll open the PR and attach the attestation dump + registry logs. RCA ticket #3422 created to track build/retag flow.

kelly: do we need a customer-facing note? nothing shipped, so internal changelog entry should suffice.

juan: add changelog line: "publish blocked by provenance mismatch; pinned to prior digest (v2026.03.20-stable) pending investigation."

deploybot: hold set on `v2026.03.20`. awaiting image `v2026.03.20-stable` + manual approval.

sam: aim: retag + approve within current change window (ends 23:30 UTC). otherwise defer to next window.

tara: ack, I'll standby until 23:30 UTC.

kelly: once PR is up, drop link here and I'll review the release note wording.

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-service/pull/679 — includes attestation trace and retag plan.

juan: follow-up: add a cheap pre-push CI step that validates manifest.label.buildid == expected CI_JOB_ID before contacting registry. should prevent this class of failure.

sam: noted and added to ticket #3422. thanks everyone — holding until retag+approve complete. :thumbsup:
